implementation_directions: F1 (Phase 05 adjudication-authority ambiguity): Split Phase 05 into Phase 05a (operator scoping decision: ratify/amend/defer) and Phase 05b (architect Pass 2a gate on implementation chain). Define adjudicated_by as a two-actor field: {operator: <id>, architect: <task-ref> | null}. Document sequencing: operator scoping first; architect gate runs on the implementation chain (Phase 06).

F2 (kind field ownership): Resolve via 'provisional_kind' rename. Phase 02 (atomic decomposition) outputs include provisional_kind. Phase 03 (categorize) confirms or overrides with canonical kind. Document the merge rule.

F3 (subject.type extension): Add a 'Schema Extensions' section noting: subject.type gains 'feedback-round-item' as new value; transitional CLI use of 'other' is acceptable until state_admin forward-track CLI code change lands; CLI code change is downstream substrate work tracked alongside Spec 08 implementation.

F4 (declaration_kind extension): Same Schema Extensions section adds operator_deliberate_deferral as new declaration_kind value; notes declaration_kind is treated as open string (canonical-value-list convention but extensible) per existing usage.

F5 (Events 9/12 inaccurate citation): EITHER add a new anti-pattern AP-6 (substrate-escalation-shape failures during feedback-round dispatch — empirical evidence: Events 9+12) — OR remove the inaccurate empirical-motivation citation. Recommend: add AP-6 since the failure modes ARE relevant to feedback-round dispatch chains.

F6 (skipped enum value undefined): Document 'skipped' semantics — 'item adjudicated as defer in Phase 05a; reconciliation_status set to skipped during Phase 07 since reconciliation is not applicable to deferred items'. Alternatively remove from enum.
F7 (two Integration with Spec 07 sections): Merge into single section. Use MUST normative weight throughout (since architect's denial cited 'an implementer must choose').

F8 (file name): Rename spec.md to surface-spec.md (per surfaces/retro/surface-spec.md convention). May require an edit that creates surface-spec.md + an edit that empties spec.md OR deletes it via separate operator-action since applier may not support delete-mode.

F9 (frontmatter non-conformant): Adjust frontmatter to match surfaces/retro/surface-spec.md conventions (drop document_kind, spec_number, version if not in canonical convention; OR document why this surface needs them).
F10 (no provenance section): Add Provenance section per existing FNSR spec convention.

F11 (AP-5 vacuous gap-16 constraint): Either rewrite AP-5 to describe the constraint in actionable terms, or remove the gap-16 reference. Recommend: keep AP-5 but tighten the language — anti-pattern is about reliance on the bypass; the gap-16 fix is in v3.2 substrate work.
F12 (BAO four-bounds missing): Add the mandatory four-bounds enumeration to the feedback-round-orchestrator BAO claim, per surfaces/_primitives/bounded-authority-orchestrator.md.

F13 (no Phase 06 re-entry after Phase 07 gap): Document re-entry path — when Phase 07 records reconciliation_status: gap for an item, the operator MAY re-run Phase 06 implementation against that item; reconciliation re-runs after. Add audit-event implications.
F14 (unregistered @context URI): Either remove the @context URI from the v0.1 document, OR document it as an internal namespace placeholder with the convention pattern other surfaces follow.
